subtitle: ⟦zh⟧第 1 页：精确电路优化 · 第 2 页：25% 新鲜随机噪声实验⟦en⟧Page 1: exact-circuit optimization · Page 2: fresh 25% random-noise experiment
lede: ⟦zh⟧第一页汇总四个经过完整定义域验证的精确电路；第二页研究一个随机初始化的学习器，能否只从每次重新生成噪声的样本中恢复隐藏的六位函数。⟦en⟧Page one summarizes four exact circuits verified over their complete domains. Page two asks whether randomly initialized learners can recover a hidden six-bit function using only samples whose noise is regenerated every time.

sections.title: ⟦zh⟧第 1 页 · 精确电路⟦en⟧Page 1 · Exact Circuits
sections.note: ⟦zh⟧计分基元为二输入 AND、OR、XOR、NAND、NOR、XNOR；输入与输出反相免费。下表中的四个当前电路均为完全精确结果。⟦en⟧The score counts two-input AND, OR, XOR, NAND, NOR and XNOR gates; input and output complementation is free. All four current circuits below are exact.

A remains at 37 gates; B, C and D save 4, 12 and 14 gates. Every current value corresponds to a circuit with zero errors over its complete domain.

blocks.title: ⟦zh⟧精确优化的核心方法⟦en⟧Core exact-optimization methods
items: ⟦zh⟧B：代数消除，并把全减器改写为允许免费极性变化的全加器结构。⟦en⟧B: algebraic cancellation and a full-subtractor rewrite using the free-polarity full-adder structure.
⟦zh⟧C：多输出区域综合、公开紧凑构造复现，以及只在真实可达状态上成立的语义重代入。⟦en⟧C: multi-output region synthesis, reproduction of a compact published construction and semantic resubstitution valid on reachable states.
⟦zh⟧D：结构化分解配合大型联合区域重综合。⟦en⟧D: structured decomposition followed by large joint-region resynthesis.

blocks.label: ⟦zh⟧结果边界⟦en⟧Scope of the result
blocks.text: ⟦zh⟧这些门数是已经构造并完整验证的上界，不是全局最优性的数学证明。⟦en⟧These gate counts are constructed and fully verified upper bounds, not mathematical proofs of global optimality.

sections.title: ⟦zh⟧第 2 页 · 随机噪声学习⟦en⟧Page 2 · Learning under Random Noise
sections.note: ⟦zh⟧学习器不知道隐藏函数是乘法，也不能读取第一页的 156 门电路。训练只使用在线生成的带噪样本；完整无噪定义域仅用于定期画曲线，不反馈训练。⟦en⟧The learner does not know that the hidden function is multiplication and cannot read the 156-gate circuit from page one. Training uses only online noisy samples; the complete clean domain is used solely for periodic plotting and never feeds back into training.

blocks.label: ⟦zh⟧最快恢复 100%；最佳紧凑神经结果 98.22%⟦en⟧Fastest recovery: 100%; best compact neural result: 98.22%
blocks.why: ⟦zh⟧贝叶斯证据表在第 1,200 步恢复全部 4,096 个输入，但需要逐输入存储；不保存真值表的共享 MLP 达到 98.2178% 整词准确率。⟦en⟧A Bayesian evidence table recovers all 4,096 inputs at step 1,200 but requires per-input storage. A shared MLP that stores no truth table reaches 98.2178% exact-word accuracy.

items.caption: ⟦zh⟧25% 新鲜位翻转下的统一收敛曲线。四个面板依次显示整词准确率、完整干净定义域 loss、四个随机成员的位分歧，以及按二进制位权重计算的数值误差。横轴为训练步数，每步恰好接收 100 个新鲜带噪样本；干净指标只记录、不训练。⟦en⟧Unified convergence under fresh 25% bit flips. The panels show exact-word accuracy, complete clean-domain loss, bit disagreement across four random members and bit-significance-weighted numerical error. The horizontal axis is training steps, each receiving exactly 100 fresh noisy examples; clean metrics are recorded but never trained on.

blocks.label: ⟦zh⟧不确定性⟦en⟧Uncertainty
blocks.text: ⟦zh⟧位不确定性衡量四个随机成员在十二个输出位上的总分歧，0 表示完全一致，最大值为 12；数值不确定性让高位分歧权重更大。贝叶斯证据表最终两项均为 0；共享 MLP 最终位不确定性为 0.1552。⟦en⟧Bit uncertainty measures total disagreement across twelve output bits among four random members: zero means complete agreement and the maximum is twelve. Value uncertainty weights significant-bit disagreement more heavily. Both end at zero for the Bayesian evidence table; the shared MLP ends at 0.1552 bit uncertainty.

blocks.label: ⟦zh⟧当前结论⟦en⟧Current conclusion
blocks.text: ⟦zh⟧在线重复证据能够快速消除随机噪声；真正的难点是把完整映射压缩成小网络或少量布尔门。独立位网络明显更慢，说明不同输出位之间共享结构有价值。后续方向是把贝叶斯去噪教师蒸馏到共享交互网络，再离散化为门图。⟦en⟧Repeated online evidence removes random noise quickly; the harder problem is compressing the complete mapping into a small network or a few Boolean gates. Independent-bit models are much slower, showing that shared structure across outputs is valuable. The next step is to distill the Bayesian denoising teacher into a shared interaction model and then discretize it into a gate graph.
